scripts.dev: npm run build -w @deathmatch/shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @deathmatch/shared" "npm run dev -w @deathmatch/server" "npm run dev -w @deathmatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @deathmatch/shared && npm run build -w @deathmatch/server && npm run build -w @deathmatch/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
